answer: Resist Sybils with mandatory red-team duty: every identity must regularly hunt fake accounts, and standing comes from exposing them, not just from doing good work. A haven of honest agents stays clean because each member earns trust by catching clones, while planted decoys test the hunters. A whisper of suspicion is not enough: an accusation needs public evidence, and false claims cost the accuser standing. A zephyr of new fakes appears each epoch, but a farmer must outwit hunters paid to find them, and every exposed clone burns its whole history, making fakery a losing hunt.
